description: Our Buffalo Plaid Flannel Shirts provide a layer of unbeatable warmth and comfort. These rugged button-down flannel shirts are great for either wearing on its own or layering as a jacket. They’re made from 8-ounce heavyweight cotton fabric, and are perfect for a casual night out or a brisk stroll through the woods, park, or trail. Warmth and Comfort in a Classic Design: While sporting two functional front button flap pockets with button closures, our heavyweight 8-ounce fabric shirts feature a six-button closure down the center chest, and a button on each wrist cuff for comfortable all-day (and all-night) wear. Furthermore, both pockets are convenient for holding small, miscellaneous items. Tough and Durable Material: Who said you can’t do outdoor work in style? Our shirts are made of 100% cotton heavyweight flannel that will surely keep you warm. From a lengthy snow shoveling session, to a breezy afternoon of fall cleanup, they’ll stand the test of time and weather. The Outdoorsman’s Wardrobe: When it comes to the classic red and black plaid flannel, people usually think of a lumberjack. While we do offer this iconic pattern, our flannel shirts also come in a variety of colors. They make for a practical and robust gift to give to an outdoor-loving enthusiast, especially during the cold months. Washing Instructions: Machine wash cold with like colors. Non-Chlorine Bleach when need. Do not tumble dry. Warm iron if needed
